data class Category(
    val id: Int? = null,
    val name: String
) {
    fun toJson(): Map<String, Any?> {
        val map = mutableMapOf<String, Any?>()
        map["id"] = id
        map["name"] = name
        return map
    }

    companion object {
        fun fromJson(json: Map<String, Any?>): Category {
            return Category(
                id = (json["id"] as? Number)?.toInt(),
                name = json["name"] as String
            )
        }
    }
}

data class Error(
    val code: Int,
    val message: String
) {
    fun toJson(): Map<String, Any?> {
        val map = mutableMapOf<String, Any?>()
        map["code"] = code
        map["message"] = message
        return map
    }

    companion object {
        fun fromJson(json: Map<String, Any?>): Error {
            return Error(
                code = (json["code"] as Number).toInt(),
                message = json["message"] as String
            )
        }
    }
}

data class Pet(
    val category: Category? = null,
    val id: Int? = null,
    val name: String,
    val photoUrls: List<String>,
    val status: PetStatus? = null,
    val tags: List<Tag>? = null
) {
    fun toJson(): Map<String, Any?> {
        val map = mutableMapOf<String, Any?>()
        map["category"] = category?.toJson()
        map["id"] = id
        map["name"] = name
        map["photoUrls"] = photoUrls.map { it }
        map["status"] = status?.value
        map["tags"] = tags?.map { it.toJson() }
        return map
    }

    companion object {
        fun fromJson(json: Map<String, Any?>): Pet {
            return Pet(
                category = (json["category"] as? Map<String, Any?>)?.let { Category.fromJson(it) },
                id = (json["id"] as? Number)?.toInt(),
                name = json["name"] as String,
                photoUrls = (json["photoUrls"] as List<*>).map { it as String },
                status = (json["status"] as? String)?.let { PetStatus.fromValue(it) },
                tags = (json["tags"] as? List<*>)?.map { Tag.fromJson(it as Map<String, Any?>) }
            )
        }
    }
}

data class Tag(
    val id: Int? = null,
    val name: String
) {
    fun toJson(): Map<String, Any?> {
        val map = mutableMapOf<String, Any?>()
        map["id"] = id
        map["name"] = name
        return map
    }

    companion object {
        fun fromJson(json: Map<String, Any?>): Tag {
            return Tag(
                id = (json["id"] as? Number)?.toInt(),
                name = json["name"] as String
            )
        }
    }
}

enum class PetStatus(val value: String) {
    AVAILABLE("available"),
    PENDING("pending"),
    SOLD("sold");

    companion object {
        fun fromValue(value: String): PetStatus = values().first { it.value == value }
    }
}
